question: Where is the breath-filled vital air said to be situated within living beings?
premises: The vital air is filled with breath
It is present in living beings
It is situated in all beings
inference: The breath-filled vital air is situated within all living beings.
uncertainties: Agreement between vāyuḥ and saṃsthitam may reflect transmitted phrasing.
plain_english: The breath-filled vital air is situated in all living beings.
